leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript generics to define a custom hook with typed return values
Implement the useState hook to store window dimensions as state variables
Construct an event handler function to update state when the window resizes
Use the useEffect hook to set up and clean up window resize event listeners
Execute conditional logic to handle server-side rendering by checking for window existence
Define a custom hook function that returns an object containing width and height properties
Invoke the window object's innerWidth and innerHeight properties to get current dimensions
Apply destructuring assignment to extract width and height from the hook's return value
Control component re-renders by updating state only when window dimensions actually change
Utilize the custom hook in functional components to access responsive window size data
